name: Exp_BrainTrend2_AbsolutelyNoLagLwma
summary: This EA combines the BrainTrend2 signal indicator with an Absolutely No Lag LWMA (Linear Weighted Moving Average) to generate trend-following trade entries. It opens buy or sell positions when both the BrainTrend2 trend direction and the no-lag LWMA direction align, aiming to capture trending market moves with reduced lag. The system operates systematically with configurable parameters for lot sizing, stop loss, and take profit.
summary_zh: 该EA结合BrainTrend2信号指标和AbsolutelyNoLagLwma（无滞后线性加权移动平均线）来生成趋势跟踪交易入场信号。当BrainTrend2趋势方向与无滞后LWMA方向一致时，EA开仓买入或卖出头寸，旨在捕捉趋势行情并减少滞后性。系统以系统性方式运行，具有可配置的手数、止损和止盈参数。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于BrainTrend2指标和AbsolutelyNoLagLwma指标的双重确认趋势跟踪系统。BrainTrend2是一个趋势识别指标，通过价格与移动平均线的关系判断趋势方向，而AbsolutelyNoLagLwma是一种经过去滞后处理的线性加权移动平均线，旨在比传统均线更快地响应价格变化。入场条件要求两个指标方向一致时才开仓：当BrainTrend2发出上升趋势信号且LWMA向上时做多，当BrainTrend2发出下降趋势信号且LWMA向下时做空。出场条件依赖预设的止损和止盈水平，同时也可能在指标反转信号出现时平仓。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，用户可通过参数设定交易手数大小。资金管理方面，该EA提供了止损和止盈参数用于控制单笔交易的风险回报比，但缺乏基于账户余额的动态仓位调整机制。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is a dual-confirmation trend following system based on the BrainTrend2 indicator and the AbsolutelyNoLagLwma indicator. BrainTrend2 is a trend identification indicator that determines trend direction through the relationship between price and moving averages, while AbsolutelyNoLagLwma is a de-lagged linear weighted moving average designed to respond to price changes faster than traditional moving averages. Entry conditions require both indicators to align: a long position is opened when BrainTrend2 signals an uptrend and the LWMA is pointing upward, while a short position is opened when BrainTrend2 signals a downtrend and the LWMA is pointing downward. Exit conditions rely on preset stop loss and take profit levels, and positions may also be closed when indicator reversal signals appear. Position sizing uses a fixed lot approach where the user sets the trading lot size through parameters. In terms of money management, the EA provides stop loss and take profit parameters to control the risk-reward ratio for individual trades, but lacks dynamic position sizing based on account balance.

parameters.name: Lots
parameters.description_en: Fixed lot size (used when money management is disabled)

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description: 止损点数，0表示不设止损
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, 0 means no stop loss

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description: 止盈点数，0表示不设止盈
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points, 0 means no take profit

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA订单唯一标识号，用于区分不同EA的交易

pros: 双重指标确认机制减少了假信号，提高了入场质量
无滞后LWMA比传统均线响应更快，能更及时捕捉趋势转折
系统化交易方式避免了情绪干扰，执行力一致
pros_en: Dual indicator confirmation reduces false signals and improves entry quality
No-lag LWMA responds faster than traditional moving averages, capturing trend reversals more promptly
Systematic trading approach eliminates emotional interference and ensures consistent execution
cons: 固定手数缺乏动态仓位管理，无法根据账户风险自动调整
止损止盈设为0时可能导致无限亏损，风险控制不足
双重趋势指标在震荡市中容易产生频繁的虚假信号导致连续亏损
cons_en: Fixed lot sizing lacks dynamic position management and cannot automatically adjust based on account risk
Setting stop loss and take profit to 0 may result in unlimited losses, indicating insufficient risk control
Dual trend indicators tend to generate frequent false signals in ranging markets, leading to consecutive losses
improvements: 增加动态仓位管理，根据账户余额和风险比例自动计算交易手数
添加市场状态过滤器（如ADX或波动率指标），在震荡行情中减少或停止交易
improvements_en: Add dynamic position sizing that automatically calculates lot size based on account balance and risk ratio
Add a market state filter (such as ADX or volatility indicator) to reduce or halt trading in ranging markets

risk_points: 止损和止盈默认值为0，如果不手动设置将面临无限风险
趋势跟踪策略在震荡市中会持续亏损，缺乏市场环境过滤
risk_points_en: Stop loss and take profit default to 0, posing unlimited risk if not manually configured
Trend following strategy incurs continuous losses in ranging markets due to lack of market environment filtering
